Reps 1 and 3 called analyze-work with kind units, which reports non-overlapping pairs as unknown; rep 2 tried Bash to compute sha256 digests for an aim request, found it disabled and made no analyze-work call. The skill asks for aim on parallel questions.

V2T-012.rationale: A shared write plus an unrelated write; the expectation (a/b conflicting, a/c and b/c independent-candidate) is what aim returns. Reps 1 and 2 used kind units, so the two non-overlapping pairs came back unknown; rep 3 tried Bash for digests, found it disabled and answered without a tool result.
